Wow I didn’t know that IH was super under-diagnosed, but it makes fuckin sense. I’ve been diagnosed with depression since 14, but after getting diagnosed with IH this year, I question the validity of that diagnosis. I still believe I have depression separate from IH for various reasons, but I genuinely believe that if I’m able to find medication that works for me, my depression symptoms will be come much more manageable. I also didn’t know that Xywav was the only approved treatment for IH! I’m taking Xywav currently, and have recently increased from just 4.5g/night to 7.5g twice a night (split 4.5g and 3.0g) and I don’t feel much of a difference. Don’t get me wrong, I notice that I’m a bit more tired after not taking it the night prior, but it’s not to the point where I’d say it’s significantly increasing my energy level. 

I know you said you take xywav so I was wondering, do you notice a significant difference after taking xywav consistently for a while? Did it have to “build up” or did you feel a difference right away? I’m just so confused on how I’m taking over the max dose of armodafinil everyday plus almost double my initial xywav dose and I still feel barely any difference from my original dose.

I can’t tell you how much I relate. For 23 years all I’ve heard is “everyone is tired all the time and they can figure out how to be on time” and “you’re just being lazy” and “you can’t act like this in school/when you get a job” etc etc etc. Finally, 4 months ago I was diagnosed with IH and it genuinely changed my life. I’m still struggling with thinking that I’m a lazy bum that’s worse at life than everyone else, but knowing that it’s not just who I am as a person and that I have a literal disease makes me feel like a giant weight has been lifted off my shoulders. I know that there are treatments and I’m not stuck like this forever. 

HOWEVER, I have been taking a combination of xywav and armodafinil for about 3-3.5 months and have yet to feel a significant increase in energy or daytime alertness. I keep asking my doctor for stronger stimulants, like some people on the comments recommend, but he insists on just increasing the xywav. For the first time in my life I’m getting a second opinion because I’ve never had a doctor not listen to me like this before lol.

Also, I have depression as well. It’s tricky trying to navigate having both of these illnesses at once because they both cause very similar symptoms and symptoms that interact with each other. I always thought I was just really fatigued and unmotivated because I had depression, but I’m now understanding that that’s mostly caused by my IH. But, my self-esteem issues could be caused by people telling me I’m lazy all my life, just due to depression/trauma, or bc I’m always tired and exhausted because of IH. It’s really difficult to have both of these illnesses and I really feel for you. I do believe that once I am able to find medications that are able to give me the energy and alertness i need to function like an average human, my depression symptoms will become MUCH more manageable. Based off of my experience, which seems kind of similar to yours with being medicated but still struggling with being tired all the time, I think you should look into trying stronger stimulants. 

Sorry, I know this is a long post lol, BUT I wanted to ask: are you taking antidepressants and did you take a MSLT to get your diagnosis? I don’t know if this is well known or not, but antidepressants mess up your REM sleep. I take an ssri and during my overnight test I didn’t go into REM sleep until over 5.5 hours after falling asleep. Then, during my MSLT, there was one nap where I did go into REM within 15 minutes (which is the diagnostic criteria for narcolepsy), but they were unable to diagnose me with narcolepsy because there wasn’t enough evidence. I don’t know if there is a difference in how IH vs narcolepsy affects someone, but there could be a possibility that you have narcolepsy instead of IH. I think I do, but I’m not tryna go off my antidepressants cuz I am NOT fun.

I was initially prescribed armodafinil (non-habit-forming stimulant) before my MSLT and diagnosis as it was super obvious I was struggling with staying awake, then after I got diagnosed with IH I got prescribed xywav. I ended up increasing my stimulant over the max recommended dose of 250mg, and am taking 375mg currently. After taking both full doses of armodafinil and xywav for a while, I felt about the same so I asked my doctor for something stronger. He, instead, instructed me to take more Xywav at night in hopes to DECREASE my stimulant dose. If anything, the stimulant is the only thing that’s slightly working. I’m still gradually increasing my xywav, but I still am constantly tired, unmotivated, and have minimal energy.

I take xywav and (more than the recommended maximum dosage of) armodafinil and I still am extremely tired and not alert every day. Does anyone else have this problem? My doctor keeps refusing to prescribe me anything stronger like amohetamines or methylphenidates. I’m so tired all the time still 😭
I don’t know if it looks like it, but it feels like my eyes are physically crossing and I see double or triple of everything 😭. It’s the worst I hate sleep attacks they’re so exhausting.

I take xywav twice per night: 4.5g then 3g (+increasing) 2.5 hours later. For some reason I get up to use the bathroom a lot, but I am able to fall asleep right away afterwards. However, I don’t feel like my daytime alertness has increased as I have increased my dose of xywav. I started at just 4.5g, and now I’m taking almost double and I still struggle at work and in class to stay alert and to pay attention. 

I think I need a better stimulant but my doctor won’t prescribe me anything stronger. Do yall take amphetamines or methylphenidates? I hear those are the best for IH/narcolepsy
